m: स्वी—कार m. making one's own, appropriation, claiming, claim, BhP.; Siddh.
reception, Kathās.
assent, agreement, consent, promise, Sarvad.
स्वी—कार—ग्रह m. robbery, forcible seizure, Mcar.
स्वी—कार—पत्त्र n. a written document or will disposing of one's property, RTL. 531
स्वी—कार—रहित mfn. devoid of assent, not agreed to, W.
स्वी—कार्य mfn. to be appropriated or taken possession of Rājat.
to be received, Kathās.
to be got in one's power or won over, ib.
to be agreed or assented to, Pat.
स्वी—करणीय mfn. to be appropriated or accepted or assumed or assented to or promised, W.
स्वी—करण n. making one's own, appropriating, accepting, acquiring, Nir.; Yājñ.; Rājat.
taking to wife, marrying, Kālid. assenting, agreeing, promising, Sarvad.
a: स्वीकरणं, स्वीकारः, स्वीकृतिः — f. 1 Taking, accepting. --2 Assenting, agreeing, promising, an assent, a promise. --3 Espousal, wedding, marriage; Ś. 5.

m: स्वी—करण—कर्मन् mfn. whose function is to appropriate, Kull.
स्वी—कर्तव्य mfn. to be accepted, VarBṛS.
to be assented or agreed to, Sarvad.
स्वी—कर्तृ mfn. one who wishes to make one's own or win any one, Rājat.

स्वी—√ कृ (स्वी-). P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते (the latter older and more correct), to make one's own, win, appropriate, claim, ŚBr. &c. &c.; to take to one's self, choose (with or without भार्यार्थे, ‘to take for a wife, marry’; स्नुषा-त्वेन, ‘for a daughter-in-law’), R.; Kathās.; Rājat.; to win power over (hearts &c.), Daś.; BhP.; (Ā.) to admit, assent or agree to, ratify, Hit.; Sarvad. : Caus. -कारयति, to cause any one to appropriate, present any one with (two acc.), Rājat.
a: स्वीकृ — {c8c} U. 1 To make one's own, appropriate, claim. --2 To take, accept. --3 To admit, grant, assume (in argument). --4 To assent or agree to, accede.

m: स्वी—कृत mfn. appropriated, accepted, admitted, claimed, agreed, assented to, promised, Kāv.; Pur. &c.
स्वी—कृति f. taking possession of, appropriation, HPariś.
